speaker: P2
text: I have nothing left. The wall won't move.

speaker: P1
text: You aren't fighting a wall. You're fighting your mind.

speaker: P2
text: Look at my hands! They bleed. I'm exhausted.

speaker: P1
text: Blood washes off. Fatigue passes. A broken spirit stays broken.

speaker: P2
text: Others reach the light while I stay in the dark!

speaker: P1
text: Seeds start in the dark. You aren't buried. You're planted.

speaker: P2
text: How long must I endure this?

speaker: P1
text: Until pain stops scaring you. Until the weight feels light.

speaker: P1
text: Then rise again. The mountain ignores stumbles. It only asks you to climb.

speaker: P1
text: Lift your head. Stand tall. Strike again.
